description:
Follow-up to bedrock-q67.25, which proved the pattern with ONE parameter: desired_commit_proxies now lives at \xff/system/config/desired_commit_proxies, seeded once by recovery and read back by the commit-proxy startup phase (FDB's \xff/conf/commit_proxies, SystemData.cpp:1005 / ClusterRecovery.actor.cpp:1191).

The rest stay in the object-storage cluster bootstrap because they have no keyspace-side reader yet, and writing them ahead of one is the inventory q67.31 deleted:
- desired_logs is consumed by initialization_phase.ex:35 and log_recovery_planning_phase.ex:57, BOTH of which run before the metadata shard is readable. Moving it needs the consumer to move, not just the value.
- desired_coordinators, desired_read_version_proxies, ping_rate_in_hz, retransmission_rate_in_hz, transaction_window_in_ms: no live consumer at all today.
- empty_transaction_timeout_ms is written to the bootstrap by persistence_phase but NOT read back by coordinator/server.ex build_parameters, so it always resolves to the 1_000 default - an existing divergence worth fixing when it moves.
- policies.allow_volunteer_nodes_to_join: Config.allow_volunteer_nodes_to_join?/1 has no callers.

Also carried over from q67.25's 2026-08-20T22:39 census comment:
(1) replication_factor is re-derived as max(1, map_size(logs)) at topology_phase.ex:214 and in the streaming path while desired_replication_factor goes unread - config authority should make the keyspace copy the single source.
(2) Decide the cold-boot anchor's MINIMUM contents once the migration is complete.
(3) Document the boundary: the coordinator raft service directory is pre-recovery discovery input ONLY (FDB CC-registration analogue, also not keyspace); nothing steady-state may read it.

Two mechanics to revisit when the family gains its second member:
- SystemKeys.Values pins config values to pos_integer (encode_config_integer/decode_config_integer) and Values.decode_for/2 dispatches on the family, not the name. A boolean or string parameter needs per-name dispatch.
- SystemKeys.Reader.decode_config_parameters/1 fails the WHOLE read on any undecodable value, so a parameter an older node cannot interpret stalls its recovery with no operator remedy. FDB tolerates: DatabaseConfiguration::fromKeyValues discards setInternal's return value, so an unrecognized \xff/conf key is skipped. Revisit the policy when the family is heterogeneous or version-skewed.
title: Cluster config: migrate the remaining parameters/policies to \xFF/system/config as their readers land
